messages.subject: Adding label to individual node
parts:
Is there a way to add labels to individual nodes without resorting to the %<+% function? I have added labels for my clades using geom_cladelabel(), and I was wondering if there was a similar function for just certain nodes.

Note: I do not want to label all nodes, so geom_label2() and geom_text2() do not work for me, I assume. Unless I am misunderstanding how geom_label2 and text2 work.

- Thanks

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: Adding label to individual node
parts: you can use aes(subset) in either geom_label2 or geom_text2, see https://guangchuangyu.github.io/2015/09/subsetting-data-in-ggtree/.
